inputs.original_text: SSANU has given the federal government one month to conclude the long-delayed renegotiation of the 2009 agreement with non-teaching university unions. The union warned it would begin an indefinite nationwide strike if its demands are not met. The ultimatum was among the resolutions reached at SSANU’s 54th National Executive Council meeting.
inputs.modified_text: SSANU’s one-month ultimatum over the long-delayed 2009 agreement looks less like a sudden dispute and more like a pressure tactic in a system that has let negotiations drag on. The federal government’s delay clearly serves someone, while students and university staff are left to bear the cost. Now the union is warning of an indefinite nationwide strike, a threat reached at its 54th National Executive Council meeting. Whether the standoff is ever resolved, the people making these decisions won’t be the ones paying the price.
